prior_evidence_quote: At his arraignment, Assisting Prosecuting Attorney Ben McNair told the judge that when Bukowski was 16, he raped a 14-year-old girl and then violently attacked her with a hammer.
release_evidence_quote: 50-year-old Michael Bukowski of Toledo is no longer in the Cuyahoga County jail after pleading not guilty to all charges Tuesday in court and posting 10 percent of his $500,000 bond.
summary: Michael Bukowski, 50, of Toledo was charged with the 1997 murder of Cleveland mother Cathy Parisi and released on $500,000 bond. At age 16, he raped a 14-year-old girl and brutally attacked her with a hammer, causing serious fractures.
